tools.name: search_resources
tools.description: Search ABCommunity's catalog of 12,000+ AI resources (MCP servers, tools, skills, APIs, libraries, frameworks). Filter by capabilities, resource type, supported client/platform, pricing, deployment (remote/local), open-source and verified status. Returns ranked resources with human-readable match qu

tools.name: find_mcp_for_task
tools.description: Describe in natural language what you want your AI to do. ABCommunity detects the required capabilities, searches the marketplace, and returns the recommended MCP(s) plus alternatives, with reasoning. Example: 'I want my AI to read Gmail and create Linear tasks.'

tools.name: recommend_stack
tools.description: For a multi-step workflow, recommend the set of MCPs needed, each one's role, the workflow order, and which are required vs optional. Does not pad the stack with unnecessary MCPs and reports any capabilities left uncovered.

tools.name: get_resource
tools.description: Return complete structured marketplace metadata for a resource by slug or id: capabilities, tools, transports, auth, packages, compatibility, pricing, security, quality signals, installation, versions and source links.

tools.name: compare_mcps
tools.description: Factual side-by-side comparison of two to five MCPs across capabilities, pricing, auth, deployment, maintenance, compatibility, open-source status and tool count. No subjective winner is chosen.

tools.name: get_installation
tools.description: Return the official installation method(s), config example, package info, transports, auth requirements and source references for a resource. Never fabricates commands — if nothing is recorded, it says so and points to the official docs.

tools.name: analyze_project
tools.description: Understand a project idea or repo summary and return product type, stack, stage, modules, risks, and open questions.

tools.name: plan_project_sprints
tools.description: Break a project into execution-ready sprints with tasks, acceptance criteria, risks, and next actions.

tools.name: map_resources_to_project
tools.description: Explain which ABCommunity resources apply to a project, when to use them, how to apply them, and what config/risk is involved.

tools.name: recommend_resources_for_sprint
tools.description: Recommend MCPs, skills, tools, APIs, and frameworks for one sprint in a project roadmap.

tools.name: generate_agent_blueprint
tools.description: Create role-specific agent instructions for a project sprint or area.

tools.name: generate_config_bundle
tools.description: Create safe client-specific MCP config notes, env checklist, install steps, and verification steps for selected resources.

tools.name: get_next_project_action
tools.description: Return the next most useful action for a project based on its sprint roadmap and current state.
